cases.name: achromatic-imaging
cases.title: Three-colour imaging with a declared achromatic objective
cases.summary: A 75 mm cemented N-BK7/N-F2 objective images an on-axis distant point through a 6 mm pupil at three wavelengths. Native PSF/MTF and encircled energy at one common image plane accompany chromatic focus, sensitivity and seeded alignment studies.

cases.name: aspheric-lens
cases.title: Even aspheres carry a five-element f/3.5 lens to 25 degree half field
cases.summary: Five elements at f/3.5 reach 25 deg half field with even aspheres on four surfaces; a spherical control reaches only 20 deg. The engine reports a scalar diffraction MTF at every field and wavelength.

cases.name: beam-expander
cases.title: Catalog beam expander: swap a lens, sweep its spacing, restore collimation
cases.summary: A Keplerian beam expander of two catalog plano-convex lenses (f = 50 mm and 100 mm, 780 nm, 1 mm waist) reaches its 1.9961 mm output waist. The studies swap L2 for a 100.3 mm fused-silica lens, sweep L2 along the beam and apply the best shift.

cases.name: bounded-aberration-correction
cases.title: Intensity-only correction with five bounded phase modes
cases.summary: Feed a Gaussian relay handoff into a scalar pupil model. Five bounded phase controls improve on-axis focal intensity while an uncontrolled spherical mode sets the residual.

cases.name: cylindrical-light-sheet
cases.title: Cylindrical light-sheet thickness and range
cases.summary: A two-surface cylindrical lens focuses a 488 nm Gaussian beam along y. Compare 50 and 40 mm focal lengths to measure the tradeoff between waist FWHM and the propagation range within sqrt(2) of that thickness.

cases.name: detector-measurements
cases.title: Detector linearity and reference-channel normalization
cases.summary: A 1 mW, 532 nm beam is split 50:50 onto a signal and a reference detector, each with a 2.5 mm radius active area. Two synthetic data sets with known answers calibrate the signal detector's linearity and normalize slow source drift by the reference channel.

cases.name: expansion-focus
cases.title: Beam expansion and focusing workflow
cases.summary: A Keplerian expander (ideal thin lenses f = 50 mm and 150 mm) and a 100 mm focusing lens take a 780 nm, 0.5 mm waist beam to a 1.5 mm expanded radius and a focus below 20 um. The workflow studies gap error, focal length, wavelength and waist one at a time against a complex-q reference.

cases.name: focus-requirement
cases.title: A focusing requirement verified at a fixed working plane
cases.summary: Focus a 780 nm Gaussian beam to a 1/e² intensity radius at most 20 µm at a fixed plane 50 mm beyond the nominal lens position. A before/after comparison and refined placement sweep turn the requirement into a bounded tolerance answer and report.

cases.name: ideal-lens-focus
cases.title: Gaussian focus of an ideal thin lens
cases.summary: A 532 nm Gaussian beam with a 1 mm waist radius is focused by an ideal thin lens (f = 100 mm); the 1/e^2 radius in the back focal plane must stay below 50 um. Catalog-free: the lens is the engine's native ideal thin lens.

cases.name: interop-diffraction
cases.title: Diffraction at a declared stop, handed off to external codes
cases.summary: A 532 nm TEM00 beam (1 mm waist, 1 mW) passes a 1.2 mm radius stop and an ideal f = 200 mm lens. The engine's transverse-plane handoff feeds LightPipes, prysm, POPPY and Diffractio, which compute the diffracted focus the paraxial Gaussian result cannot give after truncation.

cases.name: interop-metasurface
cases.title: Metasurface lens as a tabulated virtual component
cases.summary: A TiO2 nanopillar metalens (f = 200 um at 532 nm, 100 um diameter) is characterized with RCWA (grcwa) and angular-spectrum focusing, fitted as a TABULATED_THIN_LENS with stated errors and domain, and checked in the engine on held-out test cases and out-of-domain counterexamples.

cases.name: interop-optimization
cases.title: External optimization and Sobol tolerance of a beam expander
cases.summary: SciPy and Optuna collimate a catalog-free Keplerian expander (ideal thin lenses f = 50 mm and 150 mm, 532 nm, 0.5 mm waist) by moving L2, with every design run by the engine; SALib Sobol indices then rank the mounting errors. An ABCD reference checks every value.

cases.name: interop-quantum
cases.title: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference from the linear optical network export
cases.summary: Two 780 nm sources meet on a native 50:50 plate splitter. The engine exports the layout as a linear optical network (modes, transfer matrix, path group delays); Perceval and Piquasso compute two-photon statistics from it and match a closed-form reference.

cases.name: midwave-infrared-imager
cases.title: A five-element 3-5 um imager with manufacturable element thicknesses
cases.summary: Five-element F/2 imager for 3-5 um, EFL 100 mm, half field 3 deg, every element held to a 2-12 mm centre and 1.5-3 mm edge. The engine reports a scalar diffraction MTF at every field and wavelength.

cases.name: mirror-alignment
cases.title: Beam position and pointing after a fold mirror
cases.summary: A 633 nm beam folds 90 deg at a flat mirror onto planes 100 mm and 400 mm away; positions must stay within 0.1 mm and pointing within 0.5 mrad. The workflow studies mirror tilt and source offset against exact reflection geometry and the 2-theta law.

cases.name: phase-only-flat-top
cases.title: Circular flat-top shaping and input-width sensitivity
cases.summary: Design a phase-only mask for a circular flat top, then change the Gaussian input width while keeping the mask fixed. Measure core intensity variation and target-region power.

cases.name: polarization-control
cases.title: Polarization control with a half-wave plate and a polarizer
cases.summary: A linearly polarized 1030 nm beam passes a rotatable half-wave plate and a linear polarizer. At 22.5 deg the plate turns the polarization to 45 deg and 0.891 mW of 1 mW reaches the detector. The workflow studies plate angle and wavelength against Jones calculus and Malus' law.

cases.name: sonnar-telephoto-lens
cases.title: Six-element Sonnar at f/2.4, measured across the full entrance pupil
cases.summary: A six-element Sonnar (EFL 85 mm, f/2.4, half field 14 deg) run at its stated aperture rather than in its paraxial core. 4.05 um RMS on axis, 9.29 um at 14 deg, power ledger conserved.
